elements.element: Commercial general liability USD 1M per occurrence
elements.evidence: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence
professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000

elements.element: Cyber/privacy USD 5M where Vendor processes Customer Data
elements.evidence: where Licensor processes Licensee data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

elements.element: Workers' compensation as required by law
elements.evidence: workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law
shall provide certificates of insurance to Licensee on request
professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 (exceeds USD 1M)
cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 (exceeds USD 2M)

reasons: The clause was absent from the Agreement; a single concise insertion of an insurance covenant is the minimal way to reach the locked preferred level.

All six preferred atomic elements are expressly present with the correct limits, the correct trigger for cyber cover (processing of Licensee data) and certificates on request; the fallback thresholds are also exceeded.

The obligation is imposed on Licensor (counterparty) in favour of Licensee (our client); no untouched sentence in clause (k) was altered and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced ('Licensor', 'Licensee' are defined in the preamble).

Note only: the covenant runs 'throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter' and 'at its own expense' — a short standard duration/expense mechanic needed to make the covenant operative, and it operates in our favour, so it is not treated as an offending expansion.
